decisions.requirement: Every active user decision must be consumed by the current design or explicitly remain pending during design rebuild.
acceptance: No active decision can disappear from traceability.
Superseded decisions cannot be authoritative.

decisions.requirement: A V2 feature build must fail closed unless project and feature gates explicitly permit it.
acceptance: Every cb6-v2-clean build workflow invokes the feature gate before build work.
Design-rebuild state rejects feature builds.

decisions.requirement: At 200 m, traffic-signal marks should be slim, approximately the same visual size as at 500 m.
acceptance: Rebuilt design must consume this decision before signal implementation is enabled.

decisions.requirement: Traffic-signal coverage must include signals outside intersections and signals currently missing at some intersections.
acceptance: Rebuilt design must address acquisition completeness and real-device verification.

decisions.requirement: Signal behavior must be verified for update install as well as clean install; clean-install-only success is insufficient.
acceptance: Acceptance route contains both update-install and clean-install checks.

decisions.requirement: CoMaps standard functionality is preserved unless a CB6 requirement explicitly extends it.
acceptance: Rebuilt design identifies upstream-owned behavior and prohibits collateral replacement.

decisions.requirement: Map follows driving direction by default, supports north-lock toggle, and own-position presentation is lowered on screen without altering geographic GPS coordinates.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines follow/north-lock/offset ownership and regression route.

decisions.requirement: Initial map scale is 200 m; no automatic scale is required and the previous user scale is remembered.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines scale persistence and excludes unintended auto-scale behavior.

decisions.requirement: A NAVITIME-like current-road-name bar is presented near the bottom with orientation behavior controlled by CB6 UI settings.
acceptance: Rebuilt design uses existing routing/address state and defines lifecycle/fallback.

decisions.requirement: Convenience stores are always available as brand-specific icons without cluttering convenience-store text; static POI data should prefer native MWM when proven sufficient.
acceptance: Rebuilt design resolves native MWM evidence before any network duplicate path.

decisions.requirement: Fuel stations and required major facilities are presented through the CB6 POI strategy with scale-aware visibility and without unnecessary duplicate network POIs.
acceptance: Rebuilt design assigns authoritative data source, presentation and regression checks.

decisions.requirement: Stop signs are a dynamic road-control feature and should be shown only when relevant ahead of the vehicle.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines acquisition, direction/distance filtering and independent mark ownership.

decisions.requirement: Japanese voice search feeds the stock CoMaps SearchEngine, with on-device recognition where available and a safe fallback; no parallel search database.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines speech lifecycle, normalization, fallback and stock-result preservation.

decisions.requirement: CB6 routing may support a free-expressway-only policy inside native route calculation semantics; it must not post-filter an already calculated route.
acceptance: Rebuilt design proves native toll/access semantics before implementation.

decisions.requirement: Toll-fee display must use a traceable authoritative fee source/model and must not fabricate an exact fee from road class.
acceptance: Rebuilt design records source/version/update/offline policy before implementation.

decisions.requirement: Favorites synchronization, if implemented, preserves BookmarkManager as authority and uses item-level identity/conflict handling rather than destructive collection replacement.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines identity, conflict and transport boundaries.

decisions.requirement: App startup and navigation lifecycle must restore correct current-location/follow presentation and preserve CB6 behavior across restart/return flows.
acceptance: Rebuilt design includes startup/restart/return state transitions and real-device acceptance.

decisions.requirement: CB6 driving UI keeps compass at upper left with north-lock toggle, scale below it with tap-to-show +/- controls, current-location at lower left, settings at lower right, and supports a tap-to-hide search/menu full-map presentation.
acceptance: Rebuilt design assigns ownership and preserves touch access to current-location control.

decisions.requirement: Map presentation suppresses unnecessary address clutter while retaining scale-appropriate road names and required major-facility labels without excessive overlap.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines style/label ownership and zoom/collision verification.

decisions.requirement: Own-position/heading behavior must avoid rotation-axis offset, stationary jitter and false movement; stopped state must not present spurious driving motion.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines raw GPS versus matched position, heading source, low-speed hysteresis and real-device regression.

decisions.requirement: CB6 Navi provides a Google Maps handoff/auxiliary launch path while keeping CB6 Navi as the intended return application after navigation/arrival/restart flows where technically supported.
acceptance: Rebuilt design separates supported Android lifecycle behavior from behavior that cannot be guaranteed and defines verification.

decisions.requirement: Required major facilities such as airports, roadside stations, parks, public facilities, department stores and supermarkets support scale-aware icon/label presentation; important large facilities may use stronger labels while avoiding urban overlap.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines categories, source, zoom/priority and collision policy.

decisions.requirement: CB6 retains the requested fixed driving-camera behavior; automatic camera changes must not be introduced as collateral behavior.
acceptance: Rebuilt design identifies the accepted camera behavior and regression checks before implementation.

decisions.requirement: Core CB6 navigation remains usable without paid Google/Mapbox API registration and preserves CoMaps offline-map capability; external network supplementation cannot become the sole path for core static POIs.
acceptance: Rebuilt design documents offline/online ownership and no-paid-API dependency.

decisions.requirement: Traffic signals are not required at 1 km; close-range visibility and forward/near scaling must preserve accepted driving behavior while honoring the later slim 200 m preference.
acceptance: Rebuilt design reconciles historical frozen signal behavior with the later explicit 200 m change.

decisions.requirement: Convenience-store classification covers 7-Eleven, FamilyMart, Lawson, Seicomart, MyBasket, Ministop and Daily Yamazaki, with generic fallback and CB6-specific brand presentation.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines evidence priority and fallback without relying on historical numeric implementation IDs.

decisions.requirement: Each route candidate that includes toll roads should present the normal passenger-car toll; free sections/candidates present 0 yen, subject to an authoritative fee model being established.
acceptance: Rebuilt design defines route-candidate association, passenger-car fee semantics, 0-yen handling and source/update policy.

decisions.requirement: Historical accepted signal behavior used the established standard-size presentation at about 200 m.
acceptance: Historical only; must not be consumed as current behavior after the later explicit 200 m slim-size decision.

decisions.requirement: CB6 query normalization/aliases must feed the stock CoMaps SearchEngine consistently for keyboard, voice and show-on-map flows; do not create a parallel search behavior.
acceptance: Alias/fuzzy input reaches normal CoMaps results and preserves stock history/result selection/routing behavior.

decisions.requirement: CB6 UI supports auto, portrait and landscape orientation modes without breaking the navigation HUD/control layout.
acceptance: Auto/portrait/landscape modes preserve usable CB6 controls and road-name HUD.

decisions.requirement: Preserve stock search/history behavior and provide the required ability to delete search history/registered entries through the intended CoMaps-owned data path.
acceptance: History/registered-item deletion works without replacing stock CoMaps search/bookmark ownership.

decisions.requirement: Do not change the accepted/original vehicle icon unless the user explicitly requests a new vehicle-icon change.
acceptance: Unrelated feature work leaves the vehicle icon unchanged.

decisions.requirement: Preserve the established Hokkaido-focused CB6 operating scope when making data-source, coverage and validation decisions; do not silently broaden or narrow it.
acceptance: Rebuilt design states the Hokkaido operating/validation scope and any wider behavior is treated as compatible extension rather than an unreviewed scope change.
